headline: Leaf & brush pickup, Oct 19-30 (See details!)
description:
The Public Services Department will be performing its brush and leaf pick curbside collection soon.  

Brush collection (7-yards or less) will be October 19th – October 30th.  Leaf collection will begin October 26th and will continue until December 1st. 

Public Services collects properly bagged leaves and small piles of brush at the curb.

Leaves must be in biodegradable paper bags, no tape.

This service is not connected to trash collection and generally will not happen on the same day. Brush pickup is free during this program.

headline: Absentee Voting at City Hall: Oct 5-29
description: Westbrook residents may register to vote and/or request an absentee ballot in person at Westbrook City Hall beginning on Monday, October 5, 2026. Absentee voting at City Hall takes place during normal business hours through Thursday, October 29, 2026. All absentee ballots must be returned to Westbrook City Hall no later than 8pm on Election Day, November 3rd. Westbrook Elections Hotline: 207-591-8116.

headline: Voting & Elections guide coming Oct 20
description: Westbrook Currents will add a plain-language voting guide on October 20. It will cover where to vote, absentee deadlines, and your sample ballot. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3.

headline: Overnight Road Closure at Spring Street 10/18-10/22 (7pm-6am)
description:
A portion of Spring Street will be closed overnight for an additional week from the County Rd intersection to the South Portland City line. The nightly closure will run Sunday, October 18, through Thursday, October 22, 2026  (7pm-6am). The closure will end Friday, 10/23, at 6am. 


For general questions from abutters, please contact Shawn Powell, Site Superintendent at 207-356-3937 or SPowell@Sargent.us
